independent_calculation: Integer per-seed multiplicity weights from recorded joint seed bags, recomputed equal-seed means, pooled eligible cosine/count ratios, coverage, percentile intervals, support-gated NA and paired half-window differences.
limits: Intervals quantify variation across independent forcing seeds conditional on exact model parameters/basals/input law/windows; they do not calibrate cross-model kinetics, stationary processes, or event lifetimes.
Pooled conditional heading and usable coverage are paired estimands; low-coverage groups remain gated and contributing-seed counts are exported.
Finite half-window sensitivity remains separate from certification of stationarity.
Width/event-distance metrics are outside the explicit accepted ten-metric numerical scope and receive separate source/geometry checks.
